changes.new_text: An on-board odometer complying with the requirements of this UN Regulation shall be fitted to the vehicle to be approved.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1 of UN R39 was amended in version 2.2.0: 'onboard speedometer and' became 'on-board'; 'UN' was added.

changes.new_text: If more than one on-board speedometer or odometer is fitted to the vehicle, all these speedometers and odometers shall comply with all the requirements of this UN Regulation when displayed.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1 of UN R39 was amended in version 2.2.0: 'onboard' became 'on-board'; 'UN' was added.

changes.new_text: At the test speeds specified in paragraph 5.3.5. above, there shall be the following relationship between the speed displayed (V1) and the true speed (V2). 0 ≤ (V1 - V2) ≤ 0.1 V2 + 4 km/h
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.4 of UN R39 was amended in version 2.2.0: '5.5. **Odometer Equipment** The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to the driver.' was removed.

changes.new_text: If a setting makes it possible for a driver or ADS to select the odometer display distance in km or miles independently of the speedometer, the odometer shall identify the unit used.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.5.2 of UN R39 was amended in version 2.2.0: 'the' became 'a'; 'or ADS' was added.

changes.new_text: In the case of an electrically detectable failure preventing the odometer requirements of this UN Regulation from being met, a malfunction indication shall be provided to the driver, if applicable, if not already covered by other failure warnings and/or other failure conditions.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.11 of UN R39 was amended in version 2.2.0: 'applicable, if' was added.

changes.new_text: For vehicles other than those of category X or category Y, an on-board speedometer complying with the requirements of this UN Regulation shall be fitted.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1 of UN R39 is new in version 2.2.0: 'For vehicles other than those of category X or category Y, an on-board speedometer complying with th…'.

changes.new_text: For vehicles of category X or category Y, a speedometer may be fitted, but is not required to meet the requirements of this Regulation.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.1 of UN R39 is new in version 2.2.0: 'For vehicles of category X or category Y, a speedometer may be fitted, but is not required to meet t…'.

changes.new_text: For vehicles fitted with an ADS complying with the provisions on indicators of UN Regulation No [XXX], a speedometer complying to this UN Regulation is not required to indicate the speed while an ADS feature is active.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.2 of UN R39 is new in version 2.2.0: 'For vehicles fitted with an ADS complying with the provisions on indicators of UN Regulation No [XXX…'.

changes.new_text: Odometer equipment The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to a driver, if applicable, or any authorised person.
changes.reason: Paragraph 5.5 of UN R39 is new in version 2.2.0: 'Odometer equipment The display of the odometer shall be visible or accessible to a driver, if applic…'.

changes.new_text: In case of vehicles of categories X and Y and vehicles where an ADSF-2 is active, the malfunction shall be transmitted as a logic signal to the ADS.
